Some things are too important to leave inside a chat. So I made you a little place of our own.

From my heart

One thing I need you to know

I know that what happened hurt you and made you really upset, and honestly, I’m really upset with myself too. Maybe the hardest part for me is knowing that I was the reason you felt hurt.

I don’t want to talk about what happened or go into the details, because what matters to me right now is how you feel, and I want you to know how truly sorry I am and how much your feelings mean to me.

Maybe words won’t be enough to fix everything, and maybe just saying “I’m sorry” isn’t enough, but I really mean it from the bottom of my heart.

You are the last person in this world I would ever want to hurt, and the last person I would want to make feel bad or make question her place in my heart, even for a second.

I love you, Arwa. And your place in my heart is bigger than any situation or any words. You’re not just someone I love. You’ve become such an important part of my life, and having you in my life means more to me than I can ever explain.

I know you might need some time, and I won’t pressure you or ask you to forget everything quickly. Take your time. If you’re hurt, you have every right to feel that way, and I’ll understand.

I just hope that when you feel better and think about everything, you’ll remember that what happened doesn’t represent how much I love you or how much you mean to me.

I regret it, and I’m really disappointed in myself. All I want is to fix what I hurt and see you happy with me again.

I won’t tell you that I’ll never make a mistake, because no one can promise that. But I promise I’ll learn from anything that could ever hurt you, and I’ll be more careful with your heart and your feelings.

You’re so precious to me, Roro. Your place in my heart doesn’t need one moment to prove it.

I’m sorry for every bit of pain I caused you, and I’m sorry that the person who should be making you smile became the reason you were sad.

Forgive me when you’re ready… And please know that my heart is still right there with you, and all I want is for us to get through this and come back even stronger than before.

I love you, Arwa. And I’m truly sorry. 💗
